007 - Ein Quantum Trost.name: 007: Quantum of Solace
007 - Ein Quantum Trost.summary: In the Nintendo DS version of 007: Quantum of Solace, players control James Bond in a top-down third-person action experience that differs significantly from the console versions. Played with the system held sideways, the game relies heavily on touchscreen controls for movement, aiming, shooting, and interacting with icons. At the same time, the buttons are used mainly to initiate melee combat. It also features a progression system based on collectible casino chips and cards that can be used to enhance Bond’s abilities.

Summon Night - Twin Age.name: Summon Night: Twin Age
Summon Night - Twin Age.summary: Reiha and Aldo grew up together as brother and sister on the tropical island of Jarazi, among a race of people with beast-like features. There they learned to commune with the Nature Spirits that surrounded them. One day, the Spirits began acting strangely, prompting Reiha and Aldo to investigate. Their quest to find out who or what is behind the corruption of the Spirits will lead them back to the human lands where the cataclysm first brought them together.

Victorious - Hollywood Arts Debut.name: Victorious Hollywood Arts Debut
Victorious - Hollywood Arts Debut.summary: Victorious: Hollywood Arts Debut will immerse players in Hollywood Arts High School, where they attend a full year as a new student and enjoy adventures alongside Tori, André, Cat and the Victorious gang. Players can attend the school and experience classes and funny situations, pulled right from the show in the form of dynamic, replayable mini-games. The unique and hilarious setup allows players to decide their fate so they can rise to fame by earning a lead role in the Big Showcase, the biggest performance of the year!
